verdict.rationale: Phoenix ships official CLI tooling. The `@arizeai/phoenix-cli` package (`npx -y @arizeai/phoenix-cli setup`) is explicitly built so coding agents can set up tracing. A `px setup mcp --agent claude|codex|gemini|cursor|...` command wires agents to Phoenix, and `uvx arize-phoenix serve` starts the server from the terminal. Missing for 10: a documented full command reference beyond setup/serve (e.g., querying traces or running experiments from the CLI), and independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI usage.
